scope: Two genuinely licensed new wildlife films, four feature-observation questions, one127-word Stockente application lesson with one own course question/card, existing examination-region onward links and exact primary lesson targets. No whole-platform certification or claim of complete national examination coverage.

films.author: Frank Vincentz
films.review: Original metadata and licensing read; two independently read contact sheets and actual3s/24s/40s MP4 frames. Questions at3s/40s concern curved horns and a lighter lower torso, without asserting a bright white saddle patch.
films.limits: Wildpark, not a free-ranging population study. Recording date is not documented;17August2014 is upload context only. Original taxon names are reported as source context. No exact age, diagnosis, full group size or biological yearly cycle inferred from this short film.

biologySources.read: Gehörnentwicklung/Jägersprache: Schnecken and no regular antler-like shedding.
Kennzeichen/Widder: independent authored explanation of Schnecken and absence of regular shedding. No numerical growth/age, origin or injury claims imported.

films.author: Fiver, der Hellseher
films.review: Original summary, date, source and license read. Contact sheet and actual1s/5s/9s MP4 frames independently reviewed. Questions at1s/9s concern bill/head-neck contrast and darker folded-wing feather areas over lighter lower torso.
films.limits: Terrassenufer Dresden,1April2024. Feet remain underwater. No flight-wing feature, exact age, sex, kinship or intention inferred. The linked sound is a separate original recording.

claims.claim: Comb-like bill lamellae are bill structures rather than chewing teeth.
Mallards can retain food particles during sieving while water leaves the bill. This is neither an exclusive feeding mode nor a uniform bill design for every bird.

lesson.sourceReading: Root and independent reviewers read Berkeley Station5 physical PDF16, original WWT Dining out physical PDF1 and Brian Davis's Lamellae paragraph. One independent reviewer also rendered and visually read both PDF pages. Institutional teaching explanations are not described as new experiments. WWT and Berkeley PDFs are undated; no publication date invented.
lesson.existingContent: Löffelente portrait already explains bill filtering. This is a narrow Stockente structure/function/film application appended to the existing3-lesson Federwild course, not a new shoveler discovery or duplicated course.
lesson.visibleLimits: A submerged head does not make individual lamellae or swallowed particles visible. No imported illustration or new anatomy photograph. Existing photos stay at their audited placements.

mediaVerification.method: Whole originals verified against source sizes/SHA1. Complete original and output decode, actual MP4 frame counts and H264/YUV420 format, fast-start containers, whole-frame posters and exact SHA256 checked. No crop, montage, generative media or speed change.
mediaVerification.limitations: Distributed frame review is not uninterrupted visual playback, listening, physical-device verification or authenticated production course viewing.

rejectedCandidate.reason: Aerial distant flock, unsuitable for the proposed individual wing-feature exercise. Not included in product, manifest or public allowlist.

integration.profileLink: Only a ready valid explicit examination target changes the existing onward law link. SSR/unready fallback remains neutral. Read-only child leaves video, answers, playback identity and profile unchanged.
integration.courseLink: Only a uniquely owned primary lesson anchor under the exact existing course is retained; secondary courses remain their own entry. No external or invented target accepted.
integration.search: New media descriptions report their actual two questions; existing three-question descriptions remain unchanged. Completion text no longer falsely promises three questions for every film.
integration.discovery: Original film objects, sources, questions and order preserved except for the named additions. Lightweight directory carries no answer keys or full media data.
integration.security: Exact public media/license-document allowlists only; no folder-prefix exception, no new API permission or account/role/payment change. Neighboring private/answer paths and APIs remain guarded.
integration.offline: Full lesson metadata/evidence and question use the existing explicit pack pipeline. No automatic video download or new offline schema.
